purpose: The frozen material one clean installation of the product is driven through: an approved case document, the adapter configuration that names the one shipped family and the directory it reads, the material one run is compared over, and the held evidence, candidate and declared outputs that directory carries. The whole tree is the contents of a records root, so a caller copies it into a working directory and drives the installed command over it without reading anything from a source checkout.
